rounds.text: Solex Energy Ltd is trading at a heavily discounted P/E of 11.1x [E1] and 9.95x against a sector benchmark of 33.24x [E6], alongside an EV/EBITDA of 6.45x compared to the sector's 329.57x [E11]. This valuation disconnect occurs despite stellar fundamentals, featuring a 5-year compounded profit growth of 122% [E19] and a recent net profit surge of 358% year-over-year [E66]. The company generates elite returns, boasting a 37.95% ROE and 27.38% ROCE that easily outpace sector benchmarks [E9, E10], while maintaining exceptional cash conversion of 2.40x where profits are fully backed by cash [E33]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow analysis indicates an intrinsic value of Rs 3357 against a market price of Rs 911, offering a massive 72.9% margin of safety [E44, E45], with a reverse DCF showing the current price implies zero earnings growth [E46]. Promoters have also demonstrated strong long-term conviction by raising their stake to 66.15% from 43.49% [E40]. Conceded: the stock is lagging the market with a relative-strength rating of 0, trading below its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E49, E50], and debt has risen to Rs 324 Cr alongside an increase in debtor days [E38, E61].

The business carries severe leverage and cash-flow strain despite headline growth, with debt-to-equity sitting at 1.33x as borrowings more than doubled to Rs 324 Cr in March 2026 [E37, E38]. This aggressive capital expansion has driven debtor days higher from 61.9 to 77.6 days, signalling deteriorating working capital efficiency [E61]. Market participation reflects deep underlying distress, with the stock trading near its 52-week low at just 7% to 10% of its range, sitting well below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E5, E47, E49]. Institutional money flow reads negative with an absolute relative-strength rating of 0 against the Nifty 500, compounded by a sharp 37% twelve-month price decline and an annualized volatility of 70.8% [E43, E50, E51, E53]. Conceded: the company displays strong historical profit growth and high return on equity metrics [E58, E59].

Conceded: debt-to-equity is 1.33x with borrowings at Rs 324 Cr [E37, E38], and debtor days have increased to 77.6 [E61]. However, this leverage is fully productive: cash conversion reads an exceptionally strong 2.40x where profits are completely backed by operating cash flow of Rs 214 Cr, which equals 133% of operating profit [E33, E34, E36]. Conceded: the price sits low in its 52-week range and below its moving averages [E5, E49], but this represents stale sentiment ignoring that results score a maximum 100/100 with net profit surging 358% year-over-year [E71]. The bear's focus on lagging relative strength and negative institutional flow [E43, E50] completely dismisses a phenomenal fundamental reality: a reverse DCF proves today's price prices in zero growth against an 18% base-case assumption, and fundamentals are vastly outpacing price action [E46, E55].

Conceded: the company posted net profit surging 358% year-over-year [E71], and a reverse DCF indicates today's price implies zero growth [E46]. However, pointing to operating cash flow of Rs 214 Cr [E34] ignores the severe strain of ballooning borrowings, which surged from Rs 148 Cr to Rs 324 Cr in a single year, pushing debt-to-equity to a risky 1.33x where debt exceeds net worth [E37, E38]. Conceded: the bull highlights robust cash generation [E33], but working capital efficiency is deteriorating as debtor days worsen significantly from 61.9 to 77.6 days [E61]. The dismissal of lagging relative strength and institutional outflow is unjustified because a relative-strength rating of 0 against the Nifty 500, a price sitting near its 52-week low, and trading below both the 50-day and 200-day moving averages reflect intense downward momentum and negative institutional money flow (-0.36 percentage points) rather than merely stale sentiment [E43, E47, E49, E50]. Furthermore, an annualised volatility of 70.8% and a record peak-to-trough drawdown of -65.9% highlight extreme structural risks that a low valuation multiple cannot automatically neutralize [E52, E53].
